### Summary

These all seem to be attempting to clone private repositories, so I guess they shouldn't be exposed to users?

```
failures:
    pip_install::install_git_private_https_multiple_pat
    pip_install::install_git_private_https_pat
    pip_install::install_git_private_https_pat_at_ref
    pip_install::install_git_private_https_pat_mixed_with_public

failures:
    edit::add_git_private_rate_limited_by_github_rest_api_403_response
    edit::add_git_private_rate_limited_by_github_rest_api_429_response
    edit::add_git_private_raw
    edit::add_git_private_source

failures:
    sync::sync_frozen_workspace_member_git_credentials
```
